title: Hardship Terms for Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program Payment Plans
content:
The hardship terms of a Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program payment plan add payments according to the meal status held on the student's active School Nutrition Services Meal Account:

| Status held on the student's active meal account | Payments added |
|---|---|
| a status whose benefit level is free, with an effective date on or before the day of the payment | 2 |
| a status whose benefit level is reduced, with an effective date on or before that day | 1 |
| any other case | none |

## Reading the meal account

- The account read is the student's active School Nutrition Services Meal Account. The status's benefit level (paid, reduced or free) and its effective date are read from that account, not from what the family reports.
- The effective date must be on or before the day of the payment. A free status that takes effect after the day of the payment adds nothing yet.
- A status at the paid benefit level adds nothing. So does a student with no active meal account.

## Examples (hypothetical)

| Meal account | Effective date of status | Payments added |
|---|---|---|
| active, benefit level free | three weeks before the payment | 2 |
| active, benefit level reduced | the day of the payment | 1 |
| active, benefit level free | the day after the payment | none |
| active, benefit level paid | any | none |
